ex.note: As fast as possible
Very easy short duration
Dead stop start and push as fast up as you can
4 secs down pause for 3 secs then explode up make sure to keep your entire body tight tense your abs and butt
Wider grip on barbell and push elbows out to emphasize upper back
Just keep doing them until you get 3 each set
Go light on these to start and go deep to get the strech
This exercise is not meant to be done with heavyweight more skill practice
Start light and over the weeks build up weight
Descent 5 secs pause for 2 secs this exercise targets, all three heads of the tricep
